instructions: Hold your booking QR up to the camera

signIn.title: QR reader
signIn.help: Paste the reader key. The council administration creates it on the facility page, under “Entrance QR readers”.
signIn.rejected: That key is not valid or the reader was removed.

camera.denied: The reader needs the camera. Allow access in the browser and try again.
camera.missing: No camera found on this device.
camera.insecure: The camera only works when the page is served over https.
camera.failed: The camera could not be started.

offline.title: No connection
offline.detail: The booking could not be checked. Try again in a moment.

result.tooEarlyDetail: Your turn is {{day}} at {{start}}. You can come in from {{from}}.
result.otherFacility: This booking is for another facility
result.unknownDetail: Check that it is the QR of a current booking.
result.notABooking: This QR is not a booking
result.notABookingDetail: Show the entry QR from “Your bookings”.
